target: Frank v0.1 / self.root on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS
hypothesis: HyperMath LawCertificate declarations require implementation-bound executable/proof validation before they may license optimizing rewrites; otherwise a false algebraic law can produce fast but semantically incorrect Frank projections.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Ordinary compiler unit/property tests plus existing LawCertificate proof_refs/test_refs are sufficient; a dedicated validation receipt contract adds complexity without measurable benefit.

external_evidence.source: Chmielewski et al. 2026, The Role of Semirings in Incremental View Maintenance
external_evidence.finding: Incremental maintenance complexity depends fundamentally on the underlying semiring.

external_evidence.source: Brinke et al. 2026, Preservation Theorems in Semiring Semantics
external_evidence.finding: Preservation properties differ across semiring classes; laws valid in one carrier need not transfer to another.

external_evidence.source: Olteanu & Zavodny 2011, Factorised Representations of Query Results
external_evidence.finding: Factorization can compress exponentially large flat query results when structural regularity permits it.

next_falsifier: When a real ClayCode/UnifiedDB HyperMath optimizer exists, inject false, stale, wrong-version and out-of-domain law certificates and compare semantic error, plan invalidation, latency and recovery against the simpler ordinary-test baseline.
